verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page that promises to help customers achieve and maintain certification, and each supported framework gets control mapping and automated control testing with evidence collection. Beyond those two marketing claims, nothing shows the story's specific first-class elements. missing for 10: evidence of the current Annex A (2022) control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
